about: Agent evaluation set (design item 70): 30 diagrams, each with one planted error that Mermaid.js 12.3.0 rejects, and the intended fix, which Mermaid.js accepts.

diagrams.error: A square bracket is never closed.
A lowercase `end` is used as a node id.
diagrams.fix: Rename the node, for example End[End].

diagrams.error: Parentheses inside an unquoted label.
`->` is not a flowchart link.
The diagram type is misspelled as `flowchat`.
A subgraph is never closed.
diagrams.broken:
flowchart TB
  subgraph Backend
    API --> DB
  Client --> API
diagrams.fixed:
flowchart TB
  subgraph Backend
    API --> DB
  end
  Client --> API

diagrams.error: Double quotes inside a square-bracket label.
diagrams.fix: Quote the label and write the inner quotes as #quot;.

diagrams.error: A node id contains a space.
diagrams.fix: Use an id without spaces and put the text in a label: Svc[My Service].

diagrams.error: A decision's curly brace is never closed.
diagrams.broken:
flowchart TD
  A{Is it valid? --> B[Yes]
diagrams.fixed:
flowchart TD
  A{Is it valid?} --> B[Yes]

diagrams.error: `//` is not a Mermaid comment.
diagrams.fixed:
flowchart LR
  %% main path
  A --> B

diagrams.error: An `alt` block is never closed.
diagrams.broken:
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Request
  alt ok
    Bob-->>Alice: Data
diagrams.fixed:
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Request
  alt ok
    Bob-->>Alice: Data
  end

diagrams.error: A message has no colon before its text.
`=>>` is not a sequence arrow.
Bob is deactivated without being activated.
diagrams.fix: Remove the deactivate line, or activate Bob first.
diagrams.fixed:
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Ping
  activate Bob
  deactivate Bob

diagrams.error: `else` appears outside an `alt` block.
diagrams.fix: Wrap the messages in alt … else … end.
diagrams.broken:
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Ping
  else retry
  Bob-->>Alice: Pong
diagrams.fixed:
sequenceDiagram
  alt first try
    Alice->>Bob: Ping
  else retry
    Bob-->>Alice: Pong
  end

diagrams.error: Generics written with angle brackets.
A relationship has no label.
diagrams.fix: Add one after a colon: CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places.

diagrams.error: `->` is not a state transition.
A class body is never closed.
diagrams.broken:
classDiagram
  class Order {
    +total: Money
  class Item

diagrams.error: `o` alone is not a cardinality.
diagrams.fix: Use a full one, such as o{ or o|.

diagrams.error: A task has no colon between its name and data.
diagrams.broken:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Design d1, 2026-01-05, 3d
diagrams.fixed:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Design :d1, 2026-01-05, 3d

diagrams.error: `dateFormatt` is misspelled.
diagrams.broken:
gantt
  dateFormatt YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Design :d1, 2026-01-05, 3d
diagrams.fixed:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Build
  Design :d1, 2026-01-05, 3d

diagrams.error: A mindmap has a second root.
diagrams.fix: Indent the second node under the root.

diagrams.error: A node's square bracket is never closed.
A period has a trailing colon but no event, and no colon after the period.
diagrams.broken:
timeline
  title Releases
  2026 : Alpha : Beta
  section Later
  2027 Launch :
diagrams.fixed:
timeline
  title Releases
  2026 : Alpha : Beta
  section Later
  2027 : Launch

diagrams.error: A data list is never closed.
A Sankey row has no value.
A packet field has no colon after its bit range.
A service is placed in a group that doesn't exist.
diagrams.fix: Use the declared group: in api.
diagrams.broken:
architecture-beta
  group api(cloud)[API]
  service db(database)[Database] in backend
diagrams.fixed:
architecture-beta
  group api(cloud)[API]
  service db(database)[Database] in api

diagrams.error: `space:x` needs a number of columns.
diagrams.broken:
block-beta
  columns 3
  a b c d
  space:x
diagrams.fixed:
block-beta
  columns 3
  a b c d
  space:2
